name: Blood of the Future
source:
The futuristic utopian city of Elysium stands as a technological marvel. Built by a genius roboticist known only as "Doctor H" and her lesser known partner, "Doctor P", these two scientists find themselves reconnecting after years apart. However, they find themselves haunted by both their pasts and their ambitions for the future.

[From [url=https://telltaletypist.itch.io/blood-of-the-future]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
未来乌托邦城市极乐世界堪称科技奇迹。由一位天才机器人专家“H博士”和她鲜为人知的搭档“P博士”建造，这两位科学家发现自己在分开多年后重新建立了联系。然而，他们发现自己被过去和未来的野心所困扰。

[来自[url=https://telltaletypist.itch.io/blood-of-the-future]Itch.io[/url]]
